review.instructions: maestro-cms is an app-neutral library: product policy from Morris, Cooper or Maestro must not leak into it, and core packages stay provider- and storage-neutral (optional adapters live in subpackages). docs/spec-v1.md is the planning document and the ADRs in docs/adr are the decisions of record; a limitation an ADR documents is deliberate, not a defect, but drift between the code and those documents is. Each PR body lists what it intentionally does not do.
